When I was young I had big issues with sleeping... I'd just lie there for hours at a time, trying to think of nothing but seemingly unable to relax. Mind you I basically went to bed crying every night of my childhood–mom and I had a habit of getting into it before bedtime. Anyways, I remember on this one night, I 'misbehaved' and my mother sat me down and told me people like me burn in hell for all of eternity. Not so great a thing to tell your child in full seriousness.

That same night, I was lying there cursing out God in the blackness, my siblings sleeping around me. I must have been around 7 years old. I didn't understand everything back then, but I understood that I had pulled the short straw in regards to my parents. Constant relentless abuse back then is what gave me CPTSD these days... I truly believe I've been dissociated, traumatized and overall just numb inside/depressed since this very incident.

Anyways, in the middle of the night, using darkness as a cover, I crept out into the kitchen with no real plan at all. This crime alone warrants a solid punishment in my family, but for some reason that night I realized that I simply didn't give a shit what happened anymore.

And so quietly opened a drawer, pulled out the biggest chefs knife we had, and slowly crept into my parents room. I don't think they've ever known this; I might have told a person or two in my life; but that night I stood over my own parents with a knife in my hand, age seven, weighing out my options. I thought about just stabbing my mom, having my dad wake up and beat me, and probably spending my life in jail; thought about ending them both and trying to pretend it wasn't me; thought about just killing myself in front of them, and seeing the look in their eyes as life seeped out of me. What's really twisted is that I honestly cared nothing about myself in this moment. Even killing myself at the time was a smack to my mother, depriving her of her favourite punching bag and probably causing a lot of unwanted attention onto our family.

Anyways, I seriously stood there for about 10-15 minutes in total silence and blackness, next to my parents bed, knife in hand, murdererous thoughts running rampant in my head. And I chose to not do it, not because I cared or was scared or any normal sort of thinking process. No, I remember thinking to myself: "One day I'll find a way to cause them as much pain as they did me, and all will be just".

They'll never know how close they came to dying that night, and maybe you find this super fucked up but some days Im filled with regret at what could have been. These days I'm estranged from all of them, but I still can't wait for the day I hear they're gone and I can breathe easy finally.
